target.description: Canonical repository target observed by the host before any managed state is interpreted.

config_present.description: Whether the canonical shared configuration source exists; absence selects repository defaults.

repo_config.description: Decoded shared configuration observed at the canonical source; only compatibility and invocation fields affect this admission.

local_config.description: Decoded local configuration used solely to identify the established recovery invocation.

source_errors.description: Host source-read failures that must prevent successful admission.

package.description: Product package whose reader is being admitted.

version.description: Product release identity observed from its package authority, distinct from the Rust crate version.

reader_epoch.description: Reader contract epoch implemented by this executing artifact.

reader_capabilities.description: Reader features implemented by this executing artifact, compared with current repository requirements.

observed_runtime.description: Identity and supported reader capabilities observed from the executing package, never supplied by ordinary start callers.

description: Trusted pre-state configuration and reader observations; not public authority input.
title: Pre-state reader compatibility observations
